releaseNotes:
Bike Sync 2.2.0 activates secure automatic updates.

- Verified releases now install automatically when the preference is enabled.
- Bike Sync checks at startup and every six hours while running, and retries after network failures.
- The previous app remains available as a backup if an update cannot be completed.
- The app now displays its installed version, current release notes, update status, and cumulative update log.
- The 2.1.2 cache correction is included, so a calendar-only refresh cannot hide fuller Intervals.icu training data.
